label: Getting there
value: About 20 km from Mingora and the Butkara Stupa
quote: It is located about 20 km (12 mi) away from Mingora and the Butkara Stupa.

label: Excavations
quote: The Italian Archaeological Mission (renamed ISMEO) founded by Giuseppe Tucci has been excavating ruins of the ancient town of Bazira under Barikot since 1984.

label: What to see
value: A defensive wall with massive rectangular bastions
quote: It was surrounded by a defensive wall with massive rectangular bastions.

label: Size of the town
value: About 12 ha at its peak, 7 ha without the acropolis
quote: The 2nd century BC town covered, at its peak, an area of about 12 ha (30 acres) including the acropolis, or about 7 ha (17 acres) without.

label: 327 BC
value: Macedonian siege of Bazira in autumn 327 BC
quote: Macedonian siege to Barikot (Bazira) occurred within this period, in autumn of 327 BC.

label: Abandoned
value: By the end of the 3rd century; probably due to earthquakes and the decline of the Kushan Empire
quote: Probably due to the damage from the earthquakes as well as the decline of the Kushan Empire, Bazira was abandoned by the end of the 3rd century.
